bugs_found: compound_interest silently truncates fractional years/compounds_per_year via int(), changing financial results without validation
loan_payment silently truncates fractional months via int(), changing financial results without validation
transfer is not atomic: debit occurs before credit, so a failure during credit can leave balances inconsistent
transfer does not coerce/validate amount as Decimal/finite, unlike other functions, causing TypeError or invalid Decimal values at runtime
fx_convert truncates currency codes with from_currency[:3]/to_currency[:3], allowing malformed or longer codes to map to unintended rates
fx_convert does not validate rate is positive/finite, allowing negative, zero, NaN, or infinite conversion outputs
money outputs are never quantized to currency scale, allowing fractional-cent amounts and silent precision inconsistencies
